metaTitle: Custom Dog Tags with Zipper | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom dog tags with zipper for secure storage. Perfect for ID badges and keys. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Dog tags with a zippered closure keep contents secure and organized, making them ideal for safety managers and HR directors who need to issue ID badges or keys to employees. Unlike open pouches, the zipper prevents items from falling out during daily wear, adding durability for industrial or outdoor use. Choose from nylon or vinyl materials, and add your logo with screen printing or debossing for a professional look that lasts.
heroAltText: Custom dog tags with zipper featuring a secure zippered closure and logo imprint, ideal for ID badges and keys.
